div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 在开放世界地形或后期管线中合成远景辐射 L_obj 与大气散射气辉 L_sky?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 未衰减原物体辐射 · 远山与地平线按 1+u 暴亮至 2.0000× 产生发光白带!

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 缺失日光内散射气辉 · 远山按 1-u 变暗成死黑剪影!

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 计算透射率 T = exp -σ_t·d 与不透明度 u = 1 - T

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 执行严格凸组合: L_out = L_obj * 1-u + L_sky * u = mix L_obj, L_sky, u
